model: V-O tight-binding model, version v0 (parameter-free reference Hamiltonian + orbital-resolved charge response)
paper: J.-q. Lu, A Parameter-Free Reference Hamiltonian for Tight-Binding Vanadium Oxides, arXiv:2610.17687 (2026), https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17687

reference_atoms.description: neutral, unconfined, all-electron PBE atoms; the reference density is their superposition
reference_atoms.scalar_relativistic_onsite_correction: difference between the shell's scalar-relativistic and nonrelativistic atomic eigenvalues, added as (S diag d + diag d S)/2 before the core projection

derivative_radials.members: family of confined 3d radials at 3d occupations 4, 4 +/- 0.05, 4 +/- 0.10, 4 +/- 0.20 (spin-restricted) about 3d4 4s1; each member sign-aligned (positive at 1.5 bohr), then continued with its own eigenvalue in the potential of the reference-occupation basis atom
derivative_radials.family_common_r_m: smallest natural matching radius over the family
derivative_radials.family_common_support: largest natural support over the family, recomputed with the common matching radius
derivative_radials.dR_3d/dn_3d: central difference over the members at 4 and 4 +/- 0.05 (step 0.05 e), after continuation and closure; orthogonalized to R_3d; normalized
derivative_radials.d2R_3d/dn_3d^2: central second difference over the members at 4 and 4 +/- 0.05 (step 0.05 e); orthogonalized to R_3d and dR_3d/dn_3d; normalized

declared_tails.continuation: WKB form in the atom's own potential beyond the matching radius r_m
declared_tails.matching_rule: beyond 4 bohr (radials) or 5 bohr (densities): first stretch of >= 1 bohr with D <= 0.15, then the first sustained departure (D > 0.15 over >= 0.5 bohr); r_m = departure - 0.5 bohr (half the blend window) - 0.10 bohr
declared_tails.orbital_support_threshold: r^2 R^2 below 1e-14 of its maximum
declared_tails.closure: multiply by 1 - (35x^4 - 84x^5 + 70x^6 - 20x^7), x = (r - r_s + w)/w on [r_s - w, r_s], zero beyond r_s; w = min(1, (r_s - r_m)/4) for radials (then renormalized to the original norm) or min(2, max(1, (r_s - r_m)/4)) for densities
declared_tails.departure_measure: D(r) = |kappa_num - kappa_WKB| / kappa_WKB; orbitals: kappa_num = -d ln|R|/dr, densities: kappa_num = -(1/2) d ln rho/dr, both averaged over a running 0.5 bohr window; kappa_WKB = kappa + 1/r + kappa'/(2 kappa) in both cases (for densities this is -(1/2) d ln rho_WKB/dr)
declared_tails.blend: s = (1 - cos(pi x))/2, x = (r - r_m + 0.5)/1.0 clipped to [0, 1]
declared_tails.charge_restoration: full neutrality deficit Z - 4 pi int r^2 rho dr of the continued and closed density restored by the bump sin^2[pi (r - a)/(b - a)], a = 0.25 r_s < r < b = 0.5 r_s, normalized with 4 pi r^2 dr
declared_tails.oxygen_density: the O density support (11.53) lies inside the 1 bohr blend window around its matching radius (11.58): the density is cut off within the blend and has no fully WKB outer segment
declared_tails.support_crossing: log-linear interpolation of the threshold crossing between grid points

C0.core_shift_coulomb: two-centre reduction (analytic angular reduction, numerical radial integration)

core_shift_xc_and_dX_quadrature.note: exchange-correlation non-additivity uses the Becke-partitioned spheres; core-level shifts are integrated over each atom's sphere without a partition; their Coulomb part uses the two-centre reduction

charge_response.mapping: charge-conserving, Coulomb metric; free-atom occupations on the first radial of each shell
charge_response.kernel: Gamma = D J D, D = diag(s_c), J_cc' = (1/Omega) sum_{G != 0} 4 pi / (|G|^2 + eta) F_c*(G) F_c'(G)

note: Radii, supports and matching radii are quoted to 0.01 bohr as in the paper; they follow from the rules given here.

numerical_construction.atomic_solver: skprogs slateratom (PBE), reference atoms unconfined, basis atoms confined as listed
numerical_construction.dense_tables: logarithmic radial grid with ratio 1.01; cubic splines in ln r (functions), of r v (potentials), of ln rho (densities)
